name: God's Eye View
summary: Browser spy-satellite simulator on a photorealistic 3D globe with live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and cameras.
description: A real-time intelligence console for planet Earth that runs in the browser, built on a photorealistic 3D globe; the data is live and comes from public sources. Layers include aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras, with hands-free voice control powered by a realtime AI agent. Starts with no API keys needed, and optional keys unlock extra capabilities.
contains: photorealistic 3D globe with live data layers
aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras
hands-free voice control via a realtime AI agent
runs in the browser; installs via Pinokio or runs locally
starts without API keys; optional keys unlock capabilities
